scope: Avoid owned staging copies for synchronous MLINESTYLE linetype output while preserving resolved names and emitted tag order.

implementation.change: writeMLineStyle stores std::string_view entries sourced from immutable caller element strings, stable writing-context LTYPE map keys, or the BYLAYER literal. dxfSymbolNameKey accepts string_view and creates the same owned uppercase lookup key.
implementation.copyAvoidance: Eliminates the per-element owned lineType string and owning staging-vector copies. This is source-level evidence only; no allocation/RSS/throughput measurement was made.
implementation.lifetimeInvariant: All views remain valid through the synchronous MLINESTYLE emission loop; source element strings and the context map are not mutated by this writer path, and BYLAYER is a string literal.

cases: empty linetype name resolved through its handle to a writing-context LTYPE name
following MLINE record and sentinel framing
